evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Understand codebase health and identify genuine quality improvement opportunities.
intent.acceptance: Partial native factual facet: both published direct workflow counts equal the actual immutable run-head regular-file inventory; independently compare the basename sets. This does not accept the source's health score or claim improved repository health.

profile.authoring: Outcome-informed retrospective: source and candidate prose exposed before this explicit native-facet contract. Latest surviving marker-discovered report selected, not a representative or blind sample.

originalCensusProposal.goal: Understand codebase health and identify genuine quality improvement opportunities.
originalCensusProposal.population: The git-tracked codebase under standardized metrics-glossary scopes at each daily cutoff.
originalCensusProposal.acceptance: A selected substantive health outcome requires an independently established standard and direction; code size/churn/complexity alone are descriptive.
originalCensusProposal.evidencePlan: Retain exact cloc tracked-file inventory, metric definitions and immutable source; select one independently accepted health outcome before scoring.
originalCensusProposal.missingReason: Source defines many measurements and reports, not a single independent quality outcome or direction; no accepted health evidence collected.

grounding.quote: Analyze codebase daily: compute size, quality, health metrics. Track 7/30-day trends.

originalCensusProposal.limitation: Consistent file scoping improves measurement reliability but does not make LOC growth or shrinkage an outcome.

profile.historicalCompatibility: Only the retained run-head profile is evaluated; earlier periods are unmeasured.
profile.baseline: Actual source addition verified against its real parent, not first output or shallow boundary. No comparable outcome baseline reconstructed.

evidence.opportunity: The two source-required direct workflow Markdown/lock count cells in the latest surviving marker-discovered report.
filters: Latest surviving pre-cutoff Discussion with this exact workflow marker in the already fully acquired inventory. One selected report per workflow; all other reports remain unassessed. No random, representative, blind or complete-lifetime claim.
Only this retained run-head source era; current worker assignment requirements are not backdated.
evidence.collection: Offline deterministic original-byte verification and native oracle; no model, Git, network, target execution, or current body/state backdating.

model.architecture: Source-specific bounded factual accuracy, separately retaining full goal and unknowns.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed native keep bar or matched costs.
